Beshak hum ne aap ko khuli hui fatah ata ki hai
Taake Khuda aap ke agle pichhle tamaam ilzaamaat ko khatm kar de, aur aap par apni ne'mat ko tamaam kar de, aur aap ko seedhe raaste ki hidaayat de de
Aur zabardast tareeqe se aap ki madad kare

Wahi Khuda hai jis ne momineen ke dilon mein sukoon naazil kiya hai taake un ke imaan mein mazeed izaafa ho jaaye, aur Allah hi ke liye zameen o aasmaan ke saare lashkar hain, aur wahi tamaam baaton ka jaanne waala aur saahib-e-hikmat hai

Taake momin mard aur momina auraton ko un jannaton mein daakhil kar de jin ke neeche nahrein jaari hain, woh unhi mein hamesha rahein, aur un ki buraaiyon ko un se door kar de, aur yahi Allah ke nazdeek azeem-tareen kaamyaabi hai

Aur munaafiq mard, munaafiq auratein aur mushrik mard o aurat jo Khuda ke baare mein bure bure khayaalaat rakhte hain un sab par azaab naazil kare. Un ke sar azaab ki gardish hai aur un par Allah ka ghazab hai, Khuda ne un par la'nat ki hai aur un ke liye Jahannam ko muhayya kiya hai jo badtareen anjaam hai
Aur Allah hi ke liye zameen o aasmaan ke saare lashkar hain, aur woh saahib-e-izzat bhi hai aur saahib-e-hikmat bhi hai
Paighambar! Hum ne aap ko gawaahi dene waala, bashaarat dene waala aur azaab-e-Ilaahi se daraane waala bana kar bheja hai
Taake tum sab Allah aur us ke Rasool par imaan le aao aur us ki madad karo aur us ka ehteraam karo, aur subah o shaam Allah ki tasbeeh karte raho

Beshak jo log aap ki bai'at karte hain woh dar-haqeeqat Allah ki bai'at karte hain, aur un ke haathon ke oopar Allah hi ka haath hai. Ab us ke baad jo bai'at ko tod deta hai woh apne hi khilaaf iqdaam karta hai, aur jo ahd-e-Ilaahi ko poora karta hai Khuda anqareeb usi ko ajr-e-azeem ata karega

Anqareeb yeh peechhe reh jaane waale ganwaar aap se kahenge ke hamaare amwaal aur aulaad ne masroof kar liya tha, lihaaza aap hamaare haq mein istighfaar kar dein. Yeh apni zabaan se woh keh rahe hain jo yaqeenan un ke dil mein nahin hai. To aap keh dijiye ke agar Khuda tumhein nuqsaan pahunchaana chaahe ya faaida hi pahunchaana chaahe to kaun hai jo us ke muqaable mein tumhaare umoor ka ikhtiyaar rakhta hai. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke Allah tumhaare aamaal se khoob baakhabar hai

Asl mein tumhaara khayaal yeh tha ke Rasool aur saahibaan-e-imaan ab apne ghar waalon tak palat kar nahin aa sakte hain, aur is baat ko tumhaare dilon mein khoob saja diya gaya tha, aur tum ne bad-gumaani se kaam liya, aur tum halaak ho jaane waali qaum ho
Aur jo bhi Khuda o Rasool par imaan na laaega hum ne aise kaafireen ke liye Jahannam ka intezaam kar rakha hai
Aur Allah hi ke liye zameen o aasmaan ka mulk hai. Woh jis ko chaahta hai bakhsh deta hai aur jis par chaahta hai azaab karta hai, aur Allah bahut bakhshne waala meharbaan hai

Anqareeb yeh peechhe reh jaane waale tum se kahenge jab tum maal-e-ghaneemat lene ke liye jaane lagoge ke ijaazat do hum bhi tumhaare saath chale chalein. Yeh chaahte hain ke Allah ke kalaam ko tabdeel kar dein. To tum keh do ke tum log hamaare saath nahin aa sakte ho, Allah ne yeh baat pehle se tai kar di hai. Phir yeh kahenge ke tum log hum se hasad rakhte ho, haalaanke haqeeqat yeh hai ke yeh log baat ko bahut kam samajh paate hain

Aap in peechhe reh jaane waalon se keh dein ke anqareeb tumhein ek aisi qaum ki taraf bulaaya jaaega jo intehaai sakht jangjoo qaum hogi, ke tum un se jang hi karte rahoge ya woh musalmaan ho jaayenge. To agar tum Khuda ki itaa'at karoge to woh tumhein behtareen ajr inaayat karega, aur agar phir munh pher loge jis tarah pehle kiya tha to tumhein dardnaak azaab ke zariye saza dega

Andhe aadmi ke liye koi gunaah nahin hai aur langde aadmi ke liye bhi koi gunaah nahin hai aur mareez ki bhi koi zimmedaari nahin hai. Aur jo Allah aur us ke Rasool ki itaa'at karega Khuda us ko aisi jannaton mein daakhil karega jin ke neeche nahrein jaari hongi, aur jo roo-gardaani karega woh use dardnaak azaab ki saza dega

Yaqeenan Khuda saahibaan-e-imaan se us waqt raazi ho gaya jab woh darakht ke neeche aap ki bai'at kar rahe the. Phir us ne woh sab kuch dekh liya jo un ke dilon mein tha, to un par sukoon naazil kar diya aur inhein us ke iwaz qareebi fatah inaayat kar di
Aur bahut se manaafe bhi de diye jinhein woh haasil karenge, aur Allah har ek par ghaalib aane waala aur saahib-e-hikmat hai

Us ne tum se bahut se fawaaid ka waada kiya hai jinhein tum haasil karoge, phir is ghaneemat-e-Khaibar ko fauran ata kar diya, aur logon ke haathon ko tum se rok diya, aur taake yeh saahibaan-e-imaan ke liye ek qudrat ki nishaani bane, aur woh tumhein seedhe raaste ki hidaayat de de
Aur doosri ghaneematein jin par tum qaadir nahin ho sake Khuda un par bhi haawi hai, aur Khuda to har shai par qudrat rakhne waala hai
Aur agar yeh kuffaar tum se jang karte to yaqeenan munh pher kar bhaag jaate, aur phir inhein koi sarparast aur madadgaar naseeb na hota
Yeh Allah ki ek sunnat hai jo pehle bhi guzar chuki hai, aur tum Allah ke tareeqe mein hargiz koi tabdeeli nahin paaoge
Wahi Khuda hai jis ne kuffaar ke haathon ko tum se aur tumhaare haathon ko un se sarhad-e-Makka ke andar tumhaare fatah pa jaane ke baad bhi rok diya, aur Allah tumhaare aamaal se khoob baakhabar hai

Yahi woh log hain jinhon ne kufr ikhtiyaar kiya aur tum ko Masjid-ul-Haraam mein daakhil hone se rok diya, aur qurbaani ke jaanwaron ko rok diya ke woh apni manzil par pahunchne se ruke rahe. Aur agar saahib-e-imaan mard aur ba-imaan auratein na hotin jin ko tum nahin jaante the, aur naadaanistagi mein inhein bhi paamaal kar daalne ka khatra tha, aur is tarah tumhein la-ilmi ki wajah se nuqsaan pahunch jaata, to tumhein roka bhi na jaata. Roka is liye taake Khuda jise chaahe use apni rehmat mein daakhil kar le. Ke yeh log alag ho jaate to hum kuffaar ko dardnaak azaab mein mubtala kar dete

Yeh us waqt ki baat hai jab kuffaar ne apne dilon mein zamaana-e-jaahiliyat jaisi zidd qaraar de li thi ke tum ko Makka mein daakhil na hone denge, to Allah ne apne Rasool aur saahibaan-e-imaan par sukoon naazil kar diya aur inhein kalima-e-taqwa par qaaim rakha, aur woh usi ke haqdaar aur ahl bhi the, aur Allah to har shai ka jaanne waala hai

Beshak Khuda ne apne Rasool ko bilkul sachcha khwaab dikhlaaya tha ke Khuda ne chaaha to tum log Masjid-ul-Haraam mein amn o sukoon ke saath sar ke baal munda kar aur thode se baal kaat kar daakhil hoge, aur tumhein kisi tarah ka khauf na hoga. To use woh bhi maaloom tha jo tumhein nahin maaloom tha, to us ne fatah-e-Makka se pehle ek qareebi fatah qaraar de di
Wahi woh Khuda hai jis ne apne Rasool ko hidaayat aur deen-e-haq ke saath bheja taake use tamaam adyaan-e-aalam par ghaalib banaaye, aur gawaahi ke liye bas Khuda hi kaafi hai

Muhammad (s) Allah ke Rasool hain, aur jo log un ke saath hain woh kuffaar ke liye sakht-tareen aur aapas mein intehaai rahamdil hain. Tum inhein dekhoge ke baargaah-e-Ahadiyyat mein sar-kham kiye hue sajda-rez hain aur apne Parwardigar se fazl o karam aur us ki khushnoodi ke talabgaar hain. Kasrat-e-sujood ki bina par un ke chehron par sajde ke nishaanaat paaye jaate hain. Yahi un ki misaal Tauraat mein hai aur yahi un ki sifat Injeel mein hai, jaise koi khaiti ho jo pehle sooi nikaale, phir use mazboot banaaye, phir woh moti ho jaaye aur phir apne pairon par khadi ho jaaye ke kaashtkaaron ko khush karne lage, taake un ke zariye kuffaar ko jalaaya jaaye. Aur Allah ne saahibaan-e-imaan o amal-e-saaleh se maghfirat aur azeem ajr ka waada kiya hai
